plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Massangeana'
plants.tip: Brown leaf tips come from fluoride in tap water, not dry air. Use rainwater or filtered water.
plants.colour: Arching mid-green leaves with a broad yellow-green central stripe

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Lemon Lime'
plants.tip: The lime edges wash out in a dim corner. Keep it in bright indirect light to hold the contrast.
plants.colour: Grey-green centre with bright chartreuse and white edge stripes

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Warneckii'
plants.tip: Let the top few centimetres dry before watering. Sitting wet rots the cane from the base up.
plants.colour: Stiff grey-green leaves with thin white edge stripes

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'White Jewel'
plants.tip: The white tissue burns in direct sun. Bright indirect light only, and keep water off the crown.
plants.colour: Deep green leaves with broad white margins

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Janet Craig'
plants.tip: The most shade-tolerant of the group, but growth stalls in true gloom. Dust the leaves regularly.
plants.colour: Glossy, solid dark green, softly arching

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Janet Craig Compacta'
plants.tip: Slow by nature, so do not overfeed to force it. One feed a month through summer is plenty.
plants.colour: Short, tight rosettes of glossy dark green

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Limelight'
plants.tip: The newest leaves carry the colour and darken with age. Keep it out of direct sun.
plants.colour: Broad, luminous yellow-green leaves ageing to lime

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Dorado'
plants.tip: Narrow leaves lose water quickly. Water when the top third of the pot is dry, not by the calendar.
plants.colour: Narrow dark green leaves edged in creamy yellow

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Lemon Surprise'
plants.tip: The twisted leaves trap water in the crown. Water the compost, not the rosette, to avoid rot.
plants.colour: Twisted lime-green leaves with white and dark green striping

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Malaika'
plants.tip: Cut a bare cane at any height and it branches from just below the cut within a few weeks.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with a white central stripe

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Art'
plants.tip: Feed in spring and summer only. Salt building up from year-round feeding scorches the leaf tips.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with a wide lime-green centre

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Steudneri'
plants.tip: The broadest leaves of the group. Turn the pot monthly or it leans hard towards the window.
plants.colour: Very broad, plain deep green leaves

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Rikki'
plants.tip: Water much less in winter. Cold compost that stays wet is the usual cause of a collapsed cane.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with a narrow yellow central stripe

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Golden Coast'
plants.tip: Keep it slightly pot-bound. A large pot leaves wet compost the roots cannot reach for weeks.
plants.colour: Glossy green leaves with a clean yellow margin

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Cintho'
plants.tip: Tough and slow. Water every couple of weeks and leave it in place; it resents being moved about.
plants.colour: Deep glossy green, upright and broad-leaved

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Bausei'
plants.tip: The white band scorches in direct sun. Filtered light keeps the stripe clean and unmarked.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with a broad white central band

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Lindenii'
plants.tip: The reverse of the corn plant: the colour sits at the margins, and it fades if the light is poor.
plants.colour: Mid-green leaves edged with creamy yellow bands

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Jade Jewel'
plants.tip: Reverted all-green shoots grow faster and take over. Cut them out as soon as you notice them.
plants.colour: Deep green leaves with a wide creamy white centre

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Green Jewel'
plants.tip: Wipe the leaves every few weeks. Dust cuts the light it receives more than its position does.
plants.colour: Uniform deep green, broad and glossy

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Michiko'
plants.tip: Dense whorls hold moisture. Water at the compost and give it some air movement to stop spotting.
plants.colour: Narrow, dark green leaves in dense whorls

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Lisa'
plants.tip: The straight canes need decent light to stay straight. In shade the new growth leans and thins.
plants.colour: Upright, narrow, very dark green leaves

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Hawaiian Sunshine'
plants.tip: Brown tips mean salts. Flush the pot through with plenty of water every few months to wash them out.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with a soft light green central stripe

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Roehrs Gold'
plants.tip: Little chlorophyll in the pale tissue, so it grows slowly. Do not push it along with extra feed.
plants.colour: Creamy yellow leaves with fine green striping

plants.name: Dracaena fragrans 'Tornado'
plants.tip: Grown for the twist, which only holds in good light. In shade the new leaves come out flat.
plants.colour: Short twisted leaves banded cream and grey-green

plants.name: Dracaena marginata 'Tricolor'
plants.tip: The pink edge needs bright light. Softened water is high in sodium and browns the tips.
plants.colour: Narrow green leaves striped cream with red margins

plants.name: Dracaena marginata 'Colorama'
plants.tip: Nearly all pink tissue, so it needs the brightest indirect spot you have or it fades to green.
plants.colour: Narrow leaves dominated by broad pink-red margins

plants.name: Dracaena marginata 'Bicolor'
plants.tip: Drought-tolerant once established. Let the pot dry two thirds down before watering again.
plants.colour: Green leaves with clean red-pink edges

plants.name: Dracaena marginata 'Tarzan'
plants.tip: Heavier heads than the ordinary form, so pot it deep and firm or it topples as the compost dries.
plants.colour: Thick stems with wide, stiff dark green leaves edged red

plants.name: Dracaena marginata 'Magenta'
plants.tip: Water every couple of weeks and no more. Yellowing lower leaves usually mean the pot stayed wet.
plants.colour: Deep green leaves with wide purple-red margins

plants.name: Dracaena marginata 'Kiwi'
plants.tip: All three colours only show in good light. A shaded plant loses the yellow first, then the red.
plants.colour: Green and yellow striped leaves with thin red edges

plants.name: Dracaena reflexa 'Song of Jamaica'
plants.tip: Dense whorls of short leaves. Prune the tips to keep it bushy; it branches readily where cut.
plants.colour: Short dark green leaves with pale green margins

plants.name: Dracaena reflexa 'Anita'
plants.tip: Fine leaves dry out fast. Check the compost weekly rather than watering to a fixed schedule.
plants.colour: Very narrow, plain bright green leaves in tight whorls

plants.name: Dracaena surculosa (gold dust dracaena)
plants.tip: Unlike its tree relatives this one wants humidity. Group it with other plants or use a pebble tray.
plants.colour: Oval dark green leaves speckled with cream spots

plants.name: Dracaena surculosa 'Florida Beauty'
plants.tip: The heavy spotting needs bright indirect light. In shade the new leaves come out plain green.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves heavily blotched with cream

plants.name: Dracaena surculosa 'Milky Way'
plants.tip: Shrubby rather than tree-like. Pinch the shoot tips or it grows thin and leggy within a season.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with a broad white central stripe and cream spots

plants.name: Dracaena draco (dragon tree)
plants.tip: Grow it in gritty compost and water sparingly. Wet roots through a cold winter will kill it.
plants.colour: Stiff blue-grey sword leaves in a dense rosette

plants.name: Dracaena cinnabari (dragon's blood tree)
plants.tip: Very slow and drought-adapted. Water only once the compost is dry throughout, and less in winter.
plants.colour: Stiff blue-green leaves on an umbrella-shaped crown

plants.name: Dracaena arborea
plants.tip: It grows tall and top-heavy. A wide, heavy pot keeps it stable better than a deep, narrow one.
plants.colour: Thick pale trunk with long, plain green arching leaves

plants.name: Dracaena aletriformis
plants.tip: Shade-tolerant and slow. Water when the top half of the pot is dry and feed only through summer.
plants.colour: Broad, glossy strap leaves in a low spreading rosette
